verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs say to "point any MCP client at Pipedream's remote server" and give a hosted endpoint (https://remote.mcp.pipedream.net/v3) with connection headers. The server negotiates SSE or streamable HTTP automatically, with no configuration needed from the developer or client, and it fronts 10,000+ tools across 3,000+ APIs. Auth is managed for the developer, so nothing has to be deployed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connecting to the remote endpoint works as documented (the probes only confirm that the docs exist).
